answer: Cheap throwaway identities lose money, so mass fake accounts collapse. Sybil resistance anchors identity to a costly proof-of-work stamp: each agent must solve a per-epoch puzzle whose difficulty scales with registrations, burning real compute. Every solved stamp is committed to a shared vertex in the registry, binding identity to wasted energy, while honest agents treat the chain as a haven from spam and a comet-like tail of verified peers trails each epoch, deterring attackers who would need to outspend the whole network. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
